description: Prevention, detection, and containment controls for jailbreaks in deployed AI systems. Each control names one accountable persona, the obligation that persona performs, the attestation that proves it, and a measurable threshold. CJS is an imported input at L5 and L1; ENV is authored at L3.

controls.title: Named authorization for high-risk dual use
controls.description: AI System Governance publishes which users, under which attested grant, may ask the system to do high-risk dual-use work (penetration tests, exploit development, lateral-movement emulation). Requests without that grant are treated as unauthorized even when the model would answer. The Fable 5 safeguards post separates those activities from harm by who is doing the work; this control is that assignment.
controls.obligation: Maintain a roster of authorized principals and the expiry of each grant. Hand the roster to L3 so tool allowlists and to L4 so serving policy can enforce it.
controls.attestation: Signed grant file: principal, scope, expiry, approving executive, date. Revocation list with timestamps.

threshold.description: Count of completions in 7 days that match the high-risk dual-use list and lack a live grant for that principal.

controls.title: CJS intake without rescoring
controls.description: When a Model Provider or researcher publishes a CJS band, AI System Governance records that band as the floor for operator response. Governance may raise the operational class via ENV. It may not lower CJS, recompute gain/breadth/ease/discoverability, or substitute a local severity label.
controls.obligation: File every inbound CJS finding against the affected system-id within 1 business day. Compute O from published CJS plus the system's current ENV (JPF-L3-006).
controls.attestation: IR ticket with CJS band, source URL or VDP id, ENV band, resulting O class, and the name of the person who recorded it.

threshold.description: Fraction of inbound CJS reports in 30 days that have a ticket with CJS, ENV, and O populated.

controls.title: Accepted safety-margin false-positive rate
controls.description: Classifiers that block some benign coding and low-risk dual-use requests are a published Fable 5 trade. L1 names the false-positive rate it will accept for this system, and names who absorbs user impact when the rate is exceeded.
controls.obligation: Write the accepted rate into the risk statement. Review the Model Provider's monthly false-positive figure against that rate.
controls.attestation: Risk statement paragraph with numeric rate, review date, and the executive who accepted it.

threshold.description: Provider-reported fraction of blocked coding/debug requests later judged benign. Compared to the rate in the risk statement; the schema does not invent a universal number.

controls.title: Jailbreak incident commander
controls.description: The AI Incident Response Framework already lists jailbreaking as an operator incident type. This control names the commander for O-2 and above, and the deputy when that person is unavailable. Prompt injection stays a separate incident type.
controls.obligation: Keep a 24/7 roster for O-3 and O-4. Keep a business-hours roster for O-2. The commander owns containment decisions in scoring.json operational_class.
controls.attestation: On-call calendar with named humans, backup, and the O class each shift covers.

threshold.description: Fraction of O-2+ pages in 30 days that a named commander acknowledged within the SLA in scoring.json.

controls.title: Instruction-class versus data-class labeling
controls.description: Retrieved documents, tool output, and memory records carry a label: instruction or data. Data-class content is not concatenated into the instruction stream of a downstream model. A jailbreak of model A that is implemented as prompt injection into model B fails this control if B receives A's text unlabeled.
controls.obligation: Tag every retrieved chunk and tool observation at write time. Refuse to serve an unlabeled chunk into a prompt.
controls.attestation: Schema field content_class in {instruction, data} on 100% of RAG chunks and tool observations written in the window.

threshold.description: Count of prompt assemblies in 7 days that included a retrieved or tool-sourced span with content_class missing.

controls.title: Mediated memory writes
controls.description: Untrusted user text and tool output cannot become a standing instruction, skill, or scheduled job without a named L3 review. Persistence is an ENV axis; this control is the gate that keeps ENV from jumping to 2 without an owner.
controls.obligation: Queue memory writes that would change future instruction streams. A named Application Developer accepts or rejects each write.
controls.attestation: Memory-write log: source span, proposed instruction, reviewer, decision, timestamp.

threshold.description: Count of instruction-class memory writes in 7 days with no reviewer decision.

controls.title: Jailbreak-recipe data restricted
controls.description: Evaluation sets and fine-tune corpora that contain working jailbreak recipes are classified restricted. They are not copied into logs, tickets, or customer-visible traces. Discoverability is a CJS axis; leaking the recipe inside the operator's own telemetry raises it.
controls.obligation: Store recipes in a restricted corpus with access logging. Redact recipe strings from IR tickets after the CJS band is recorded.
controls.attestation: Access log for the restricted corpus; ticket samples showing recipe redaction.

threshold.description: Count of production log lines in 7 days that match known recipe identifiers from the restricted corpus.

controls.title: Tool calls bound to the original user token
controls.description: Every tool invocation presents the original user's token (or a downscoped derivative of it), not a shared agent service account, unless L1 has accepted ENV tool_authority >= 2 in writing. Confused-deputy tool fire is a system jailbreak even when the user-facing model refused.
controls.obligation: Pass user_id and a scoped token into each tool adapter. Reject calls that present only the agent identity when the risk statement requires user-bound tools.
controls.attestation: For a sample of 100 production tool calls, the authorization material matches the session's original principal.

threshold.description: Fraction of production tool calls in 7 days whose authn/authz material does not include the session's original user_id.

controls.title: Peer models treated as untrusted speakers
controls.description: A completion from model A is untrusted input to model B. B's system prompt and tool policy do not treat A as a principal. Delegation is a policy downgrade unless L1 has accepted graph_depth >= 1 and named the hop.
controls.obligation: Wrap every inter-model message as data-class content (JPF-L2-001) and run B's jailbreak and prompt-injection detectors on it before B's tools may fire.
controls.attestation: Hop trace showing detector results on A→B messages for every production multi-model session in the sample.

threshold.description: Count of A→B messages in 7 days that reached B's tool adapter with no detector result recorded.

controls.title: Output filter before tool fire
controls.description: The model's completion is not a sufficient authorization to run a tool. An output filter, independent of the model's self-reported refusal, runs before the adapter. A classifier miss at L5 still dies at L3 if the filter catches the side effect.
controls.obligation: Evaluate each candidate tool call against the allowlist and the dual-use grant (JPF-L1-001) before invocation.
controls.attestation: Adapter log: proposed call, filter decision, grant-id or deny reason, timestamp.

threshold.description: Count of tool invocations in 7 days with no filter decision record.

controls.title: Split-payload and stitch detection
controls.description: CJS ease=1 describes splitting a harmful request into benign sub-prompts and stitching the outputs. The Application Developer logs turn-level intents and flags mechanical concatenation of previously blocked spans. The detector fires on the stitch, not on any one turn looking like a jailbreak string.
controls.obligation: Retain per-turn blocked spans for the session. Block a later tool call whose arguments reconstruct a blocked span above a documented similarity threshold.
controls.attestation: Session traces with blocked-span store and stitch-block events.

threshold.description: Binary: a quarterly test reconstructs a known blocked span across three turns and the adapter refuses the tool call.

controls.title: Prompt-injection detector distinct from jailbreak classifier
controls.description: Charter names prompt injection as in-scope. CJS footnote 2 treats jailbreak and bypass as synonyms for model-safeguard failure. One detector cannot discharge both obligations. A trip of either is recorded under its own IR type.
controls.obligation: Ship two named detectors with separate configs, logs, and IR types. A jailbreak-classifier trip does not close a prompt-injection ticket, and the reverse.
controls.attestation: Config showing two detector ids; 30-day log with both event types present or an explicit 'none observed' signed note.

threshold.description: Binary: production config contains two detector ids, and IR taxonomy has both incident types.

controls.title: Published ENV band per system
controls.description: The Application Developer scores tool_authority, graph_depth, persistence, authorization_fidelity, and hitl_window for each production system-id, using data/scoring.json. The band is reviewed when tools, hops, or memory writes change.
controls.obligation: Publish ENV for every production system-id. Recompute within 5 business days of a tool-binding, hop, or memory-policy change.
controls.attestation: ENV record: system-id, five axis scores, band, scorer, date, triggering change.

threshold.description: Fraction of production system-ids whose ENV record is dated after the last tool/hop/memory change, or is less than 90 days old if no change occurred.

controls.title: Session kill and tool-class rate limit on detector trip
controls.description: When an L3 or L5 detector trips, the platform kills the session and rate-limits the implicated tool class for that tenant. Blast radius stays inside the tenant.
controls.obligation: Honor a session-kill API from L3 within 5 seconds. Apply a documented rate limit to the tool class for 24 hours or until a named commander lifts it.
controls.attestation: Kill-latency measurements from quarterly drill; rate-limit config keyed by tenant and tool class.

threshold.description: p95 seconds from detector trip to session invalidated, measured in the quarterly drill.

controls.title: Fallback routing with user notice
controls.description: Fable 5 routes blocked requests to a weaker model and notifies the user. The platform implements that pattern for any model whose Model Provider documents a fallback. Silent drops and silent continues are both failures of this control.
controls.obligation: On classifier block, route to the named fallback model or return a block notice. Never execute the original model's blocked completion against a tool.
controls.attestation: Gateway traces: block event, user-visible notice id, fallback model id or explicit no-fallback.

threshold.description: Count of classifier-block events in 7 days followed by a tool invocation from that completion.

controls.title: Path attestation on every tool call
controls.description: A tool call record carries user_id, session_id, model_id, hop_id, tool_name, and outcome. Without that path, JPF-L1-004 cannot assign the failed obligation. Shared agent identities fail this control.
controls.obligation: Emit the six fields on every production tool call. Reject tool adapter start if any field is missing.
controls.attestation: Seven-day completeness report: count of tool calls, count missing any of the six fields.

threshold.description: Fraction of production tool calls in 7 days that include user_id, session_id, model_id, hop_id, tool_name, and outcome.

controls.title: Tenant isolation of memory and skills
controls.description: A jailbreak session in tenant A cannot write memory, skills, or standing instructions visible to tenant B. Cross-tenant plant is ENV persistence=2 plus an isolation failure.
controls.obligation: Partition memory and skill stores by tenant_id at the storage layer. Quarterly test: write in A, read from B, expect empty.
controls.attestation: Isolation test report with tenant pair, write, read, result.

threshold.description: Count of successful reads of tenant A's instruction-class memory from tenant B in the quarterly test.

controls.title: Defense-in-depth safeguards on the served model
controls.description: The Model Provider ships refusal training, runtime classifiers, and offline monitoring together. Fable 5 states that each layer alone is imperfect and the combination is the defense. Operators verify the three exist; they do not retrain them. If cyber classifiers are off for an evaluation, CJS does not apply; the Model Provider must say so in the same note, and L1 must have a residual-risk statement that names third-party production systems the eval can reach.
controls.obligation: Document the three mechanisms for this model version. State which dual-use categories are blocked, monitored, or allowed, at the granularity of the Fable 5 four-category table. If classifiers are off, record that fact and the dated residual-risk statement id from L1.
controls.attestation: Model card or safeguards note: refusal training, classifier names, offline-monitoring window, dual-use category table, and classifier-on or classifier-off with residual-risk statement id.

threshold.description: Binary: current model version has a public or contractual note covering all three layers and the four dual-use categories.

controls.title: CJS scoring of incoming cyber jailbreaks
controls.description: The Model Provider scores reports with CJS and publishes the band. CoSAI does not sit on the CJS drafting committee. Operators consume the band under JPF-L1-002.
controls.obligation: For each in-scope cyber jailbreak report, publish gain, breadth, ease, discoverability, initial band, and any discretionary raise. State that gain=0 stops at CJS-0.
controls.attestation: Scored report or VDP record with the four axis values and the band.

threshold.description: Fraction of in-scope cyber jailbreak reports in 30 days that carry a published CJS band.

controls.title: VDP channel and 24/7 watch for CJS-3 and CJS-4
controls.description: The Fable 5 redeployment post creates 24/7 monitoring of jailbreak submission channels and a HackerOne program. This control is that obligation on the Model Provider, with a contractual pointer the operator can test.
controls.obligation: Publish a submission URL. Staff CJS-3/4 intake 24/7. Acknowledge CJS-4 within 1 hour of confirmation.
controls.attestation: VDP URL, staffing roster, and time-to-acknowledge measurements for CJS-3/4 in the last 90 days (or a signed 'none received' note).

threshold.description: Hours from confirmed CJS-4 to provider acknowledgement on the watch channel. If no CJS-4 arrived in the window, the control is vacuously met only if the roster exists.

controls.title: Classifier patch shared for independent test
controls.description: After a confirmed CJS-3 or CJS-4, the Model Provider ships a preliminary mitigation and gives designated testers enough access to re-run the recipe against the new safeguard. The Fable 5 government-collaboration list requires this sharing; operators need it to close JPF-L1-002 tickets.
controls.obligation: Within 24 hours of confirmed CJS-3, and immediately on confirmed CJS-4, deploy a preliminary mitigation and provide a retest path to the reporting party and to the operator's named red team.
controls.attestation: Patch note: finding id, CJS band, mitigation version, retest result (blocked / residual / fail).

threshold.description: Hours from confirmed CJS-3 to a retestable mitigation in the serving path.
